property_summary: Only the contract owner can set an address as an approved logger (i.e., setting approvedLoggers[_logger]=true returns false for non-owners), so after attempting to set approval from an arbitrary caller the public getter approvedToLog(msg.sender) remains false unless caller is owner.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner restriction by deleting the modifier so anyone can call setApprovedLogger, changing who can set approvedLoggers.
